title: Earned Wage Access Bundle Terms on Late Funding Fees — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
**Term.** On a Paystride Payroll Card Program, the late-fee charge is multiplied when the employer also runs a Paystride Earned Wage Access program whose agreement is live today and went live on or before the batch's pay date: under the employer-paid fee model — by 0.5; under any other fee model — by 0.8; with no such agreement — the charge is not multiplied under this term.

**Records read.** The employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement: its status today, its go-live date against the pay date of the late batch, and its fee model (worker-paid, employer-sponsored or employer-paid).

### Combinations

| Agreement live today | Went live on or before the batch's pay date | Fee model | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | employer-paid | 0.5 |
| yes | yes | worker-paid or employer-sponsored | 0.8 |
| yes | no — went live after the pay date | any | none |
| no — the agreement is in any status other than live, or there is none | any | any | none |

### Hypothetical figures

- An agreement live today, under the employer-sponsored fee model, that went live well before the pay date: a late-fee charge of 85.00 is multiplied by 0.8, giving 68.00.
- The same agreement under the employer-paid fee model: 85.00 multiplied by 0.5, giving 42.50.
- An agreement whose go-live date falls the day after the batch's pay date: no multiplier under this term.
